title: Plus and Square Root
statementMd:
ZS the Coder is playing a game. There is a number displayed on the screen and there are two buttons, '$+$' (plus) and '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' (square root). Initially, the number $2$ is displayed on the screen. There are $*n* + 1$ levels in the game and ZS the Coder start at the level $1$.

When ZS the Coder is at level $*k*$, he can :

1. *Press the '$+$' button*. This increases the number on the screen by exactly $*k*$. So, if the number on the screen was $*x*$, it becomes $*x* + *k*$.
2. *Press the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button*. Let the number on the screen be $*x*$. After pressing this button, the number becomes ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dd68ff2d8e5b97302506ac32d308bb521ab84a26.png). After that, ZS the Coder levels up, so his current level becomes $*k* + 1$. This button can only be pressed when $*x*$ is a **perfect square**, i.e. $*x* = *m*^{2}$ for some positive integer $*m*$.

Additionally, after each move, if ZS the Coder is at level $*k*$, and the number on the screen is $*m*$, then **$*m*$ must be a multiple of $*k*$**. Note that this condition is only checked after performing the press. For example, if ZS the Coder is at level $4$ and current number is $100$, he presses the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button and the number turns into $10$. Note that at this moment, $10$ is not divisible by $4$, but this press is still valid, because after it, ZS the Coder is at level $5$, and $10$ is divisible by $5$.

ZS the Coder needs your help in beating the game — he wants to reach level $*n* + 1$. In other words, he needs to press the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button $*n*$ times. Help him determine the number of times he should press the '$+$' button before pressing the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button at each level.

Please note that ZS the Coder wants to find just any sequence of presses allowing him to reach level $*n* + 1$, but not necessarily a sequence minimizing the number of presses.

## Input

The first and only line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$), denoting that ZS the Coder wants to reach level $*n* + 1$.

## Output

Print $*n*$ non-negative integers, one per line. $*i*$-th of them should be equal to the number of times that ZS the Coder needs to press the '$+$' button before pressing the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button at level $*i*$.

Each number in the output should not exceed $10^{18}$. However, the number on the screen **can be greater** than $10^{18}$.

It is guaranteed that at least one solution exists. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

## Note

In the first sample case:

On the first level, ZS the Coder pressed the '$+$' button $14$ times (and the number on screen is initially $2$), so the number became $2 + 14·1 = 16$. Then, ZS the Coder pressed the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button, and the number became ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c3d2663f5f74e9220fd5cbccbfaf4ca76ef7284f.png).

After that, on the second level, ZS pressed the '$+$' button $16$ times, so the number becomes $4 + 16·2 = 36$. Then, ZS pressed the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button, levelling up and changing the number into ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49ab1d31f1435b7c7b96550d63a35be671d3d85a.png).

After that, on the third level, ZS pressed the '$+$' button $46$ times, so the number becomes $6 + 46·3 = 144$. Then, ZS pressed the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button, levelling up and changing the number into ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/499b57d4b7ba5e1e0957767cc182808ca48ef722.png).

Note that $12$ is indeed divisible by $4$, so ZS the Coder can reach level $4$.

Also, note that pressing the '$+$' button $10$ times on the third level before levelling up does not work, because the number becomes $6 + 10·3 = 36$, and when the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button is pressed, the number becomes ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49ab1d31f1435b7c7b96550d63a35be671d3d85a.png) and ZS the Coder is at Level $4$. However, $6$ is not divisible by $4$ now, so this is **not a valid solution.**

In the second sample case:

On the first level, ZS the Coder pressed the '$+$' button $999999999999999998$ times (and the number on screen is initially $2$), so the number became $2 + 999999999999999998·1 = 10^{18}$. Then, ZS the Coder pressed the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button, and the number became ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f07f2a60ab6cecbd2507861a0df57a16a015fd86.png).

After that, on the second level, ZS pressed the '$+$' button $44500000000$ times, so the number becomes $10^{9} + 44500000000·2 = 9·10^{10}$. Then, ZS pressed the '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' button, levelling up and changing the number into ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4c4d8829d987a7bcfd597cd1aa101327a66c0eca.png).

Note that $300000$ is a multiple of $3$, so ZS the Coder can reach level $3$.
statementZhMd:
ZS the Coder 正在玩一个游戏。屏幕上显示着一个数字，并且有两个按钮：'$+$'（加号）和 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)'（平方根）。初始时，屏幕上显示数字 $2$。游戏共有 $*n* + 1$ 个等级，ZS the Coder 从等级 $1$ 开始。

当 ZS the Coder 处于等级 $*k*$ 时，他可以：

1. *按下 '$+$' 按钮*。屏幕上的数字恰好增加 $*k*$。也就是说，如果屏幕上的数字原本是 $*x*$，则会变为 $*x* + *k*$。
2. *按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮*。设屏幕上的数字为 $*x*$。按下此按钮后，数字会变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dd68ff2d8e5b97302506ac32d308bb521ab84a26.png)。随后，ZS the Coder 升级，因此当前等级变为 $*k* + 1$。只有当 $*x*$ 是一个**完全平方数**，即对于某个正整数 $*m*$ 有 $*x* = *m*^{2}$ 时，才能按下此按钮。

此外，每次操作后，如果 ZS the Coder 处于等级 $*k*$，且屏幕上的数字为 $*m*$，那么必须满足 **$*m*$ 是 $*k*$ 的倍数**。注意，这个条件只会在完成按键操作后检查。例如，当 ZS the Coder 处于等级 $4$ 且当前数字为 $100$ 时，他按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，数字变为 $10$。此时，$10$ 不能被 $4$ 整除，但这次操作仍然有效，因为操作完成后，ZS the Coder 处于等级 $5$，且 $10$ 能被 $5$ 整除。

ZS the Coder 需要你的帮助来通关——他想要到达等级 $*n* + 1$。换句话说，他需要按下 $*n*$ 次 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮。请帮助他确定在每个等级按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮之前，应按下多少次 '$+$' 按钮。

请注意，ZS the Coder 只需要找到任意一组能够到达等级 $*n* + 1$ 的按键序列，不一定要使按键次数最少。

## 输入格式

输入仅包含一行，其中包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$），表示 ZS the Coder 想要到达等级 $*n* + 1$。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个非负整数，每行一个。第 $*i*$ 个数应等于 ZS the Coder 在等级 $*i*$ 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮之前需要按下 '$+$' 按钮的次数。

输出中的每个数都不应超过 $10^{18}$。但是，屏幕上的数字**可以大于** $10^{18}$。

保证至少存在一组解。如果有多组解，输出任意一组即可。

## 说明

在第一个样例中：

在第一个等级，ZS the Coder 按下了 $14$ 次 '$+$' 按钮（屏幕上的数字初始为 $2$），因此数字变为 $2 + 14·1 = 16$。随后，ZS the Coder 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c3d2663f5f74e9220fd5cbccbfaf4ca76ef7284f.png)。

之后，在第二个等级，ZS 按下了 $16$ 次 '$+$' 按钮，因此数字变为 $4 + 16·2 = 36$。随后，ZS 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，等级提升，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49ab1d31f1435b7c7b96550d63a35be671d3d85a.png)。

之后，在第三个等级，ZS 按下了 $46$ 次 '$+$' 按钮，因此数字变为 $6 + 46·3 = 144$。随后，ZS 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，等级提升，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/499b57d4b7ba5e1e0957767cc182808ca48ef722.png)。

注意，$12$ 确实能被 $4$ 整除，因此 ZS the Coder 可以到达等级 $4$。

另外，在第三个等级升级前按下 $10$ 次 '$+$' 按钮是不可行的，因为数字会变为 $6 + 10·3 = 36$；当按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮后，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49ab1d31f1435b7c7b96550d63a35be671d3d85a.png)，且 ZS the Coder 处于等级 $4$。然而，此时 $6$ 不能被 $4$ 整除，因此这**不是一组有效解**。

在第二个样例中：

在第一个等级，ZS the Coder 按下了 $999999999999999998$ 次 '$+$' 按钮（屏幕上的数字初始为 $2$），因此数字变为 $2 + 999999999999999998·1 = 10^{18}$。随后，ZS the Coder 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f07f2a60ab6cecbd2507861a0df57a16a015fd86.png)。

之后，在第二个等级，ZS 按下了 $44500000000$ 次 '$+$' 按钮，因此数字变为 $10^{9} + 44500000000·2 = 9·10^{10}$。随后，ZS 按下 '![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c77ded9b8209a8cb488cc2ec7b7fe1dae32a5309.png)' 按钮，等级提升，数字变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4c4d8829d987a7bcfd597cd1aa101327a66c0eca.png)。

注意，$300000$ 是 $3$ 的倍数，因此 ZS the Coder 可以到达等级 $3$。
